meta.title: ArchiveSignals
meta.description: Fired by the 'Archive' button on any Signals List screen (None/Contact/Group). Operates only on the currently selected signals (session:selectedSignalIds via the row checkboxes / Select All/None/Invert) — the button is inactive/disabled whenever the selection is empty. A common flow is Select All then Archive, sweeping every currently-visible signal off the screen in one go.
